repair — 修理
Last month, the residents of Willow Street started a Repair Café in the community hall.

volunteer — 志愿者
"If you show me how to fix it, I will try at home." Tom, a volunteer, shows her the steps.

switch — 开关
"The switch is broken," she says.

loose — 松的
"Because the switch is loose, the light does not work," he explains.

tighten — 拧紧
"Therefore, we must tighten it." Mei fixes the lamp in ten minutes.

sew — 缝补
"I cannot sew," he says.

needle — 针
"You should use a strong needle," she says.

dust — 灰尘
